# KASHFARA VISION

> 4-Billion-Parameter OCR + Vision Document Intelligence Platform for Arabic & English Enterprise Documents.

Website: https://kashfara.com
Live Demo: https://kashfara.com/demo

## What Kashfara Vision Does
Kashfara Vision combines fast structural OCR parsing with multimodal vision reasoning to extract structured data from Arabic (RTL), English (LTR), and bilingual documents with low compute and high accuracy.

## Core Capabilities
- **Hybrid OCR + Vision Pipeline**: Parses native PDF text layers and Office structures first, then runs multimodal vision reasoning for layout, handwriting, stamps, and signatures.
- **Proof-of-Evidence Verification**: Every extracted field includes its original label, normalized value, exact page number, verbatim source quote, and normalized bounding-box coordinates.
- **Automatic Form Digitalisation**: Detects fillable forms and converts them into editable digital schemas with Arabic RTL toggle, JSON export, CSV export, and print-ready output.
- **Document-Grounded Q&A**: Answers questions strictly from the uploaded document with clickable page citations.
- **Supported Formats**: PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP, TIFF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX.

## Enterprise Business Domains
- **Finance & Accounting**: Arabic-English VAT / ZATCA / FTA invoices, bank statements, purchase orders, receipts.
- **Banking & FinTech**: Corporate onboarding packs, balance sheets, trade finance documents.
- **Legal & Enterprise HR**: Bilingual contracts, NDAs, employment agreements, onboarding forms.
- **Logistics & Supply Chain**: Bills of Lading, delivery notes, packing lists, shipping manifests.
- **Real Estate & Property**: Commercial leases, valuations, handover checklists.
- **Healthcare & Insurance**: Medical claims, policy schedules, lab reports, intake forms.
